text:
Sam: Quick heads-up: animation on slide 4 is firing late in rehearsal, causing the demo to start before the slide is visible. Need a 20s buffer after roadmap.
Tanya: Copy. I can disable the auto-animate and push a static slide ASAP. Will update notes to include +20s buffer.
Ben: Ops: rehearsal recorder showed a short 18s gap when we switched scenes. Can you spin up fallback and confirm upload hook?
OpsBot: Starting fallback recorder on node-4 :white_check_mark:
Tanya: Running fallback recorder now:
```
recorderctl start --session allhands-3332 --dest /mnt/recs/allhands-3332-fallback.mp4 --fallback node-4
```
RecorderBot: Fallback recording started (id: rb-3332)
Sam: Also seeing a mild caption drift (~6s) when presenters overlap. Please trigger a caption resync immediately after roadmap.
Tanya: Will trigger resync + add 25s buffer to slideshow timings.
Mia (CEO): We'll call out the slide animation issue at the intro and reserve time for pricing Qs. Keep Dedicated autoscaler marked as "planned (Q2)" in the roadmap.
Ben: Noted. Product, please have a PM ready for commit/pricing questions (monthly vs annual flexibility).
Sam: @Ben can you also verify audio routing? Stage A had a low hum in dry run. If it shows up live we'll cut to lav quickly.
Ben: Routing checked, hum source was stage amp. Patch applied, levels look clean. Backup audio route set to mesa-backup.
InfraBot: ingest-monitor: obs-node-4 jitter under 1% last 5m. No action required.
Tanya: Slide deck v6 uploaded: https://drive/internal/allhands/deck-v6-static.pptx — notes updated.
Sam: Great. Tanya, when recorder upload completes, please attach to INF-1102 and ping thread.
Tanya: INF-1102 created. Will attach raw + trimmed clip after session.
Mia (CEO): We'll take top 3 Qs at the end, prioritize pricing, autoscaler timeline, and Private deployment onboarding ETA.
Ben: Who's moderating Qs? I can surface top ones to Mia, but need someone to triage live chat.
Sam: I'll moderate and pin pricing questions. Ben, can you export a 10m highlight for comms after the meeting?
Ben: Yep, will trim and upload post-session.
Tanya: Caption resync triggered :hourglass_flowing_sand:
RecorderBot: Upload queued: will attach to INF-1102 when complete.
Sam: Feed looks stable. Captions re-synced. Disabling animation on slide 4 succeeded.
Mia (CEO): Thanks everyone for the quick fixes. Reminder: mention autoscaler status in roadmap callout.
Tanya: Upload complete: https://internal-storage/recs/allhands-3332-fallback.mp4 :rocket: Attached to INF-1102.
Sam: Post-meeting checklist: Tanya attach raw + INF-1102 (done), Ben export highlight clip, Product to send pricing FAQ to Comms, Sam to send prioritized Qs to Mia.
Mia (CEO): Perfect. Closing thread and moving to live. Good luck all.
